children.game_version: A bird-mimicry game where children pair up and follow the leader's hopping patterns.

seniors.seated_version: Rhythmic upper body swaying and arm movements mimicking bird gestures.
seniors.standing_version: Stepping in place without jumping, focusing on the courtship arm gestures.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo, limited range of motion.

signature_moves.description: Dancers perform movements that represent the falling in love of birds.
signature_moves.name: Bird courtship mimicry

music_profile.sound_description: Lively and cheerful brass-led music designed to accompany high-energy dance.

teaching.level_notes: Requires high energy and stamina due to the jumping nature of the dance.
